notes: Prompt delivery is ARGUMENT: official docs verify `claude -p "query"`, and piped stdin in text mode is documented as data/context alongside an argument prompt - a prompt supplied ONLY via stdin is not documented, so this adapter passes the prompt as a single quoted argument. readonly maps to --permission-mode plan (reads, no edits). acceptEdits auto-approves file edits. auto mode lets a classifier review actions instead of the user. NEVER emitted: --dangerously-skip-permissions / bypassPermissions (blocked by design; see SECURITY.md). Model aliases with brackets (e.g. opus[1m]) are rejected by the runner's model pattern; use full model names or plain aliases. Config surface: project .claude/settings(.local).json allow-rules and hooks, and .mcp.json MCP servers in the job's cwd, apply to bridge jobs and are NOT bounded by the job's mode - see SECURITY.md. authCheck runs 'claude auth status': it reads stored credentials and can report logged in while the underlying OAuth session is expired and unrefreshable (observed live: auth status green, the real run failed with 'OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed'); preflight cannot detect that state for this adapter - if a first job fails with that error, sign in interactively on the machine.
